verdict.rationale: Wise documents the banking pieces: multi-currency accounts holding up to 56 currencies, global account details, and passthrough FDIC insurance. It also documents spend pieces (debit cards with MCC and currency spend controls and channel permissions) and outbound payments, including batch transfers of up to 1000. However, nothing shows a dedicated bill-pay or accounts-payable workflow, and much of the card and spend-control material is Platform API for partners rather than features of the Wise Business product. missing for 10: bill pay/AP workflow (invoice capture, approvals, scheduling), employee expense management, evidence the consolidated feature set is available in Wise Business itself, independent corroboration of replacing point solutions.
